# netbox_site_group (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/features/facilities/#site-groups):

> Like regions, site groups can be arranged in a recursive hierarchy for grouping sites. However, whereas regions are intended for geographic organization, site groups may be used for functional grouping. For example, you might classify sites as corporate, branch, or customer sites in addition to where they are physically located.
>
> The use of both regions and site groups affords to independent but complementary dimensions across which sites can be organized.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_site_group" "parent" {
  name        = "parent"
  description = "sample description"
}

resource "netbox_site_group" "child" {
  name        = "child"
  description = "sample description"

  parent_id = netbox_site_group.parent.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the site group.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the site group.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the site group.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the site group. Needs NetBox 4.5.0 or later.
- `parent_id` (Number) The ID of the parent associated with the site group.
- `slug` (String) The URL-friendly slug of the site group.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) When the site group was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_updated` (String) When the site group was last changed.
- `prefix_count` (Number) The number of prefix objects that refer to the site group.
- `site_count` (Number) The number of site objects that refer to the site group.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_site_group.example 1
```
